# SoraFiles

SoraFiles provides free PDF and image utilities that process supported files locally in the user's browser. Files are not uploaded to a SoraFiles processing server.

Canonical site: https://sorafiles.com/
Sitemap: https://sorafiles.com/sitemap.xml
All tools: https://sorafiles.com/preview
About: https://sorafiles.com/about
Privacy: https://sorafiles.com/privacy

Published tool categories include PDF compression and organization, PDF conversion, image conversion and compression, OCR, document protection, and metadata removal. Individual capabilities and limitations are stated on each tool page.

Product: SoraFiles
Developer: Sora Labs
